description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}, causing it to enter the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters plus an additional +1/+1 counter of each ingredient counter on Communal Brewing.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Workhorse.
Repeat step 2 until Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Workhorse dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Workhorse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Communal Brewing
uses.cardState: with three or more ingredient counters on it
